title: Hearing on the business of running child care in NYC
summary: The Council's Committee on Small Business and Subcommittee on Early Childhood Education will hold an oversight hearing examining the economics and regulation of child care businesses in New York City, including rising costs, insurance challenges and delays in background checks and permitting. The hearing will also consider a related bill requiring the Department of Small Business Services to expand its Business Pathways program for child care entrepreneurs. Witnesses include city agencies, NYCHA, child care providers, educators and parents.
